examples.solution_text:
The four regions total $10+6+9+5=30$.
a. 'Both' selects the overlap: $P(P\cap G)=\frac{6}{30}=\frac15$.
b. 'Piano only' excludes the overlap: $P(\text{piano only})=\frac{10}{30}=\frac13$.
c. Inclusive or counts all three regions inside the circles once: $P(P\cup G)=\frac{10+6+9}{30}=\frac56$.
d. Exclusive or selects the two outer regions inside the circles: $P(\text{exactly one})=\frac{10+9}{30}=\frac{19}{30}$.
e. 'No piano' includes guitar only and neither: $P(P')=\frac{9+5}{30}=\frac7{15}$.
f. 'Neither' selects only the region outside both circles: $P(\text{neither})=\frac5{30}=\frac16$.
g. 'At least one' includes both instruments: $P(\text{at least one})=\frac{25}{30}=\frac56$.
h. With two instruments, 'more than one' means both: $P(\text{more than one})=\frac6{30}=\frac15$.
i. 'At most one' includes zero instruments and excludes both: $P(\text{at most one})=\frac{10+9+5}{30}=\frac45$.

examples.question_text:
This two-way table records the destinations visited by 40 travellers.
$\begin{array}{l|r|r|r}&\text{Fiji}&\text{Not Fiji}&\text{Total}\\\hline\text{Bali}&8&12&20\\\text{Not Bali}&6&14&20\\\hline\text{Total}&14&26&40\end{array}$
One traveller is selected at random. Find the probability that they have visited:
a. Bali and Fiji
b. Fiji only
c. at least one destination
d. at most one destination
e. neither destination
f. no Fiji
g. no Bali, or Fiji, or both.
examples.solution_text:
Use the grand total, 40, as the denominator.
a. Select the Bali–Fiji cell: $P(\text{both})=\frac8{40}=\frac15$.
b. Select Fiji in the Not Bali row: $P(\text{Fiji only})=\frac6{40}=\frac3{20}$.
c. Select every data cell except neither: $P(\text{at least one})=\frac{8+12+6}{40}=\frac{13}{20}$.
d. Select every data cell except both: $P(\text{at most one})=\frac{12+6+14}{40}=\frac45$.
e. Select the Not Bali–Not Fiji cell: $P(\text{neither})=\frac{14}{40}=\frac7{20}$.
f. Select the Not Fiji column: $P(\text{no Fiji})=\frac{26}{40}=\frac{13}{20}$.
g. Select the Not Bali row and the Fiji column, counting their shared cell once: $P(\text{no Bali or Fiji, or both})=\frac{6+14+8}{40}=\frac7{10}$.
